## What's Included in the Vue Form Builder Package

The Vue Form Builder package provides a drag-and-drop form design experience for creating dynamic forms with Syncfusion® controls.

### Form Builder

The [Vue Form Builder](https://www.syncfusion.com/vue-components/?utm_source=npm&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=vue-form-builder-npm) component allows you to design and generate dynamic forms with a simple drag-and-drop interface.

<p align="center">
    <a href="https://ej2.syncfusion.com/vue/documentation/form-builder/getting-started">Getting Started</a> .
    <a href="https://ej2.syncfusion.com/vue/demos/#/tailwind3/form-builder/default.html">Online demos</a> .
    <a href="https://www.syncfusion.com/vue-components/?utm_source=npm&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=vue-form-builder-npm">Learn more</a>
</p>

#### Key features

* **Drag-and-drop form design** - Build forms quickly by dragging and dropping form fields onto the design area and rearranging them as needed.
* **Wide range of built-in form components** - Use 20+ built-in fields, including text box, dropdown list, combo box, multi-select, date picker, time picker, checkbox, radio button, slider, rating, signature, and file upload.
* **Custom components** - Extend the Form Builder by registering custom components for specialized fields and business-specific inputs.
* **Form field configuration** - Define field names, labels, placeholders, validation rules, and other properties from the properties panel.
* **Conditional logic** - Show or hide form fields dynamically based on values from other fields.
* **Dependent dropdowns** - Configure cascading dropdowns where the options in one dropdown depend on the selected value of another.
* **Expressions** - Bind calculated values to form fields using expressions so values update automatically when related fields change.
* **Form preview** - Preview the designed form at any time before saving or publishing it.
* **JSON schema viewing** - View the generated JSON schema to understand, validate, and reuse the form definition.
* **Save and load form data** - Export the designed form as JSON schema and load it back to restore the exact form layout at runtime.
* **Responsive rendering** - Create forms that adapt seamlessly to desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

## Setup

To install `form-builder` and its dependent packages, use the following command,

```sh
npm install @syncfusion/ej2-vue-form-builder
```
